103/1001.name: Calamity's Tear
103/1001.description: An item required to activate Buds on the Beacon Tree. Obtained from the Torment Rift. A sincere tear shed as the Calamity fades. It bears its final remorse, and nurtures the hope of rebirth.

103/1004001.name: Elite Nomos Cube
103/1004001.description: Used to summon Virtues. The sacred virtues of the gods are revealed in the patterns, and the weight of souls is etched into the edges.

103/1006001.name: Epic Nomos Cube
103/1006001.description: Used to summon Virtues. The sacred virtues of the gods are revealed in the patterns, and the weight of souls is etched into the edges.

103/1007.name: Elite Deity Shard
103/1007.description: Collect 60 to summon a random one of 12 Elite Deities (drop rate: 8.333%). A corner of an Elite Deity, already etched with its power.

103/1008.name: Epic Deity Shard

103/1008001.name: Legendary Nomos Cube
103/1008001.description: Used to summon Virtues. The sacred virtues of the gods are revealed in the patterns, and the weight of souls is etched into the edges.

103/1009.name: Godcall Plume
103/1009.description: An item that can be used in Standard Summon to obtain a random Deity. Dawn's light shines on the raven's wings as the threads of fate weave bonds between all.

103/1010.name: Godcall Pinion
103/1010.description: An item that can be used in Suit Summon to obtain a random Deity. Bathed in golden radiance, the wandering raven finds its path, guiding you to the deities of a certain Suit and awakening their slumbering might.

103/1011.name: Star Tracer
103/1011.description: Used for summoning in Chronos Chamber. It crawls through the seams of time, devouring the past to shape the future, bringing you ancient whispers.

103/1013.name: Luminous Key
103/1013.description: Used for summoning in the Wheel of Fate in Totem. The Wheel of Fate keeps on turning, divine virtues surface from deep within the samsara and gather in your hands as newfound power.

103/1031.name: Random Celestial Deity Shard
103/1031.description: Grants a random Celestial Shard upon use. Available Shards: Amun-Ra, Nyx, Dionysus, Nuwa, and Zeus.

103/1034.name: Refining Stone
103/1034.description: Used to reroll the attributes of an Awakened Artifact. As all things shift and the world changes, the road ahead always welcomes a fresh start.

103/1035.name: Fate Lock
103/1035.description: Locks one attribute when rerolling an Awakened Artifact's attributes. A law set millennia ago, unyielding, unbroken, and unmoved by the rise and fall of worlds.

103/1111.name: Genesis Elixir
103/1111.description: Used to upgrade Relics from Lv.0 to Lv.10. Pure, immortal, smooth as honey and wine, infused with the ancient power of origin.

103/1112.name: Apotheosis Elixir
103/1112.description: Used to upgrade Relics from Lv.10 to Lv.30. Pure, immortal, smooth as honey and wine, infused with the ancient power of rising.

103/1113.name: Eternity Elixir
103/1113.description: Used to upgrade Lv.30+ Relic. Pure, immortal, smooth as honey and wine, infused with the ancient power of everglow.

103/1114.name: Pristine Aether
103/1114.description: Used to upgrade the Throne from Lv.0 to Lv.20. The lingering breath of a deity, a miracle found everywhere.

103/1200.name: Artifact Enhancement Stone
103/1200.description: Used to enhance Awakened Artifact. Each enhancement attempt has a chance to fail. On failure, the affected attribute's level -1. Through countless trials, true power emerges.

103/1201.name: T1 Hefty Awakening Stone
103/1201.description: Used to awaken Hefty Artifacts of Divine rarity. A <color=#8dfbff>T2 Awakening Stone</color> is crafted from <color=#8dfbff>3</color> T1 Awakening Stones.

103/1202.name: T2 Hefty Awakening Stone
103/1202.description: Used to boost Hefty Artifacts from Awakening T1 to T2. A <color=#8dfbff>T3 Awakening Stone</color> is crafted from <color=#8dfbff>3</color> T2 Awakening Stones.

103/1203.name: T3 Hefty Awakening Stone

103/1204.name: T4 Hefty Awakening Stone
